results.title: U.S. midterm results could accelerate India trade deal but raise tariff risks
results.content: Democratic control of the U.S. Congress could accelerate India-U.S. trade deal negotiations, but experts warn that President Donald Trump may increase tariff pressure on India before an agreement is finalised.

results.title: Mumbai Police arrest three in Nagpur cyber fraud racket, establish links to 73 cases across India
results.content: The investigation began after police traced ₹24.75 lakh from a share trading investment fraud case registered at the South Region Cyber Police Station to a current account opened in the company’s name at the Central Bank of India’s Jaripatka branch in Nagpur

results.title: Delhi SIR: SC tells excluded voters not to fear prosecution even as ECI still insists on Form 6
results.content: On October 28, the Supreme Court made it clear that the ECI was in “error” to force pre-existing voters, deleted from the electoral rolls, to apply as new voters under Form 6 of the Registration of Electors Rules, 1960

results.content: Kotian and Suryansh Shedge will miss the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy due to the Rising Stars Asia Cup

results.title: Even as unemployment falls, lack of ‘decent work’ in India
results.content: Poor-quality employment generation has consequences for economic growth; workers without social security spend less, save less and remain vulnerable to economic shocks
